rows.grounds: final member of compound; recipients or targets
indeclinable or adjective used adverbially with ca

items.question: Which mantra syllables must be inscribed to counter all makers of obstacles?
premises: The syllable tāraṃ is specified as an object to be written.
The syllable parāṃ is specified as an object to be written.
The syllable bhū is specified as an object to be written.
The inscription is directed against all makers of obstacles.
items.inference: Therefore, one should write tāraṃ, parāṃ, and bhū as mantra syllables against all obstacle-makers.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of sarva ca in this sequence is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should write the syllables tāraṃ, parāṃ, and bhū against all those who create obstacles.
